subject: Ability registry
notes: Every line of effect text is transcribed verbatim from the in-game Active Abilities panel.
`cooldown` and `active_time` come from the in-game panel; neither published source carries them.
`note` holds the italic line the game prints under the effect - either that the ability works passively once equipped, or that it does not take up a common slot in the Active Abilities panel.
`no_common_slot` marks an ability that does not consume one of the tree's ability slots.
Activation charge and health costs to use an ability come from the in-game Cost line, cross-checked against the Fextralife ability table.
The source labels the fourth row of four-level abilities 'Lv. 3'; levels here are numbered by position.
Abilities have no prerequisites in either source - they are learned independently of the perk graph.
Gates: manual, corruption <n>, road shrine, vrakhir blood (a Phial of Vrakhir Blood), or none.
Some levels cost skill points but no time segments, so `time_segments` can be 0.
A level whose cost the game hides is one the capture's save had already bought; those costs are kept from the published tables.

`kind` is active or passive, decided by use_cost: anything that pays an activation charge or health is active. Passive abilities still take an ability slot - they work once equipped in the Active Ability panel.
`story_granted` marks an ability whose first level the story hands you: it costs no skill points and no time segments to learn. Upgrades past level 1 are paid for normally.
